hero.subtitle: Craftsmanship & CNC Technology
hero.title: Nature creates the material. We give it personality.
hero.description: We combine traditional woodworking with state-of-the-art CNC technology to create unique, durable and personalized pieces.

scene1.title: I'm Robert, from Hawaii Woodworking Sibiu.
scene1.text: I make wooden objects in my workshop, with my own hands and with the help of a CNC. Let me tell you how it all began.

scene2.title: The summer in grandma's yard
scene2.text: When I was little, I spent some time at my grandmother's in Cristian. When I went back to school in Sibiu, I showed up in the yard in shorts and a flowered T-shirt. My classmates asked me why I was dressed like that, and I told them that where I come from it's warm. “And where do you come from?” “From Hawaii.”

scene3.title: From grandma's yard to the workshop
scene3.text: The name stayed with me ever since. And my Hawaii, my grandmother's yard in Cristian, has now become the workshop where I work.

scene4.title: The first cutting board, for my mum
scene4.text: In 2020 I made a cutting board for my mother. That's when I discovered how beautiful it is to give someone something you made yourself, something they use every day and keep for years. That's how Hawaii Woodworking began.

scene5.title: Code by day, workshop by night
scene5.text: By day I work in technology and hunt for mistakes so I can fix them before they reach people. In the evening and on weekends I go into the workshop, where I'm not chasing cold perfection but character: the knots, the grain and the shades that make every piece of wood different.

scene6.title: Me and the CNC machine
scene6.text: The CNC brings the precision. I choose the wood, draw the designs, sand, finish and check every piece before it leaves for you. The machine cuts the lines, but I add the story.

scene7.title: Made with the same care
scene7.text: Whether it's a cutting board for your kitchen, an icon for someone dear or a personalized gift, I make it with the same care I put into the first cutting board for my mum.
scene7.quote: Made of wood, with soul. Made to last.
